label: Source support for 608a262d from Monadology §§32–38
note: The principle addresses the recorded brute-contingency alternative by requiring a reason for the truth in question, even when unknown. Applying it requires a world-indexed contingent existent to yield a fact of the kind Leibniz covers and its sufficient reason to supply a token for the same existence fact in the model’s explains relation. The model does not require that a token be sufficient in Leibniz’s sense.
